planned_arguments.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 digital poster for the fictional ONBIT desk lamp experience exhibition, as a photographic editorial sequence about the lamp's construction and the light it casts onto a book.

Input image 1 is the authoritative synthetic product identity reference, not a layout reference. Actually reproduce its deep forest-green finish, very wide horizontally arched half-cylinder shade with warm luminous underside, TWO cylindrical supports attached to both shade and the thick elliptical oval base. Keep the connected geometry and distinctive proportions recognizable. Show the entire lamp from shade ends to complete oval base at least once, uncropped, in the main photographic view. The reference's grey studio background and placement are free to change.

Build the whole sheet from two tightly related photographs of the SAME lamp-and-open-book setup, joined with a sharp editorial vertical seam slightly left of centre. The left photograph is an eye-level three-quarter whole-product view on a dark warm walnut desk, with a real open book in the foreground under the lamp's warm pool of light. The lamp is substantial and fully identifiable; its support connections and both shade ends are clearly separated from the background. The right photograph moves very close to the illuminated open book: tactile ivory pages, visible gutter, curved page layers at the outer edge, oblique contact shadows and a small cropped view of the same green shade's lit underside at its upper inside edge. The enlarged book's illuminated fold and its edge make the photo's depth visibly specific, not a plain blank rectangle. The seam shifts scale from product to the actual desk-light experience; warm light and the open-book shape connect across the edit. No empty-room scene, copied film-frame graphic, picture borders or poster mockup. Photographic detail, physically coherent contact and lighting, restrained natural texture. Use unprinted book pages without incidental fictional microtext.

Let the title calmly label the whole-product photograph near its upper edge, with the English product line immediately below. Give the title stronger optical mass but keep its area compact enough for the product and continuous body route. In the right-hand illuminated-page close-up, the light contact point beside the seam leads directly into the two descriptive sentences, together as one comfortable left-aligned column. Continue on the same optical start through the event name, the adjoining date/time/place group, and then the visit conditions, invitation and URL. Use one natural vertical reading route with modest functional gaps, not unrelated corner captions or a separate footer. Text remains a clean flat editorial overlay rather than distorted perspective printing on pages. Keep the photographed book's fold, paper edge and shadow visible alongside the column. Related descriptions stay adjacent with consistent leading; wrap only at semantic word spaces, no single isolated syllable or stranded punctuation. All descriptions and visit details must be comfortably readable at 720-pixel poster width, with ample real text area and contrast; reduce title/crop weight rather than shrinking body.

Body letterforms: mature low-contrast Korean/Latin sans, uniform Hangul proportions, open internal counters, moderate regular-to-medium weight, balanced Latin cap height and numerals, stable baseline, calm consistent leading and normal meaningful word spacing. Treat body as designed prose, not miniature headline glyphs. Headline can be somewhat heavier within the same restrained photographic editorial character. Dark green-black lettering over the genuinely illuminated ivory book area; warm off-white title over the darker photographic desk. Precisely finished page edges, shade rim, support joints and grounded oval base. No tape-material obligation.

Print ONLY the following exact copy, each entry exactly once, preserving all Korean/English glyphs, words, meaningful word spaces, numbers, punctuation and en dashes; layout wrapping is allowed. No extra labels, print, invented specifications, real launch claims, logo, QR, watermark or additional copy:
저녁을 켜는 빛
ONBIT / DESK LAMP
조용한 빛으로 책상 위의 시간을 바꿉니다.
넓은 갓 아래로 퍼지는 빛과 짙은 초록의 구조를 가까이에서 살펴보세요.

The image sequence, its scale change, lamp/light contact and photographic seam must organize the entire composition. Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-colour fields dominated by a big gothic headline/date/information template with an added subordinate product picture; exclude empty interior surfaces made just to hold type. Coherent photography and sans type are permitted. One single finished poster, not multiple alternative posters, a contact sheet or comparison board.
